working_definition: Organ-named cluster of the adult male reproductive tract; authors' term FBbt:00004958 is the seminal vesicle structure (enlarged distal vas deferens).
searches_performed: semen-secreting cell of the male reproductive system
justification: FBbt has no seminal vesicle cell or epithelial cell term. The only cell class mentioning seminal vesicle cells (semen-secreting cell of the male reproductive system) is a broader secretory class not established as covering all cells of this cluster, so the cluster is held rather than force a fallback.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Enlarged distal region of the vas deferens. It connects the testis, via the testicular duct, to the main region of the vas deferens.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Authors' structure term; not a cell type.

other_candidates.fbbt_term: semen-secreting cell of the male reproductive system
other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Any cell of the male reproductive system that contributes to the production and secretion of seminal fluid proteins; includes cells of the seminal vesicles.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Possible fallback but assumes a secretory identity the authors do not state; curator decision.

recommendation: Hold; a seminal vesicle cell term would be needed (not requested without curator sign-off).
